calibration.calibration: Unlabeled tracking only; missingness does not identify true occlusion causes
calibration.coordinate_errors: Assumed ranges; no coordinate ground truth available

spec.primary: Equal-provider clean official spell F1; exact-tie macro F1; +0.01 over matched baseline screen
spec.secondary: Two fixed label-free composite stress seeds averaged within match, then provider
spec.live_gap: External training labels alone locate H/A intervals; empirical aggregate gap histogram on live-time clock, clipped at dead/unknown intervals; physical error assumptions unchanged
spec.pipeline: Same 75% clean/coarse team rows and D windows; replace 25% with live-gap/fragmentation/uncertainty view; capacities unchanged
spec.gru: One bidirectional GRU hidden=24, 3 logits; 5 Hz, 10 s cores + 5 s context each side; 8 epochs, AdamW .001/.0001, batch 64, seed 2026; direct+swapped records
spec.gru_inputs: Union of existing refine_features team geometry/contact/history and player-only D motion features; finite masks and training-only normalization; identical raw evaluation views
spec.gru_training: Two original clean/coarse-ball views; quarter of whole windows replaced by baseline ball-gap or new live-gap view. Both have same source/match weights and update budget; joint loss replaces separate H/A and D losses, not a head-only ablation
spec.controls: No short-spell weighting, decoder tuning, provider calibration, optimizer sweep or source weighting sweep
spec.labels: Existing external converter targets preserved; X and native visibility grading fixed before corruption; no inferred labels from nearest-player geometry
limitations: Five reused development matches, no independent confirmation
Training live conditioning does not measure competition live-gap distribution
Synthetic tracking errors are assumptions, not transfer proof
